checkpoint_policy: write an atomic machine-readable checkpoint after every target and every subject-target block
preserve completed valid target evidence across interruption
resume only from hash-verified current-campaign checkpoints
never resume from R1-R4 working state
budget_stop_rules: stop a target after a valid frozen failure boundary rather than repeatedly tuning
do not consume independent verification reserve for worker exploration
do not exceed 125 percent of any worker-stage allocation without a new outcome-blind budget version and independent audit
stop Phase 2B if the frozen subject denominator or data-eligibility gate is not met
stop any run on repeated numerical instability, solver failure, or disk usage above 45 GiB
degradation_priority: complete valid Phase 2A assessment of all eight targets
preserve required seed and nearby-parameter robustness
reduce optional dose density or optional two-parameter surfaces
